platform.rationale: The edition is curated (specific seeds); random-at-mint launchpads would discard the selection. Artist-owned contract, batch mint of predetermined tokens with pinned images, generator archived.

chain.rationale: Strongest provenance and collector expectation for a 256-piece curated edition; gas accepted.

reserves.rationale: 12 artist proofs (highest score per style) and 12 institutional reserves (lowest-numbered plan-and-section per style); auditable like the selection.

licence.rationale: Holders and the public may share and display with attribution; commercial rights and the series identity stay with the artist; the repository stays public for verification.

title.rationale: Already frozen into every sheet's schedule and DWG ids; no re-freeze needed.

artist.derivation: Isopsephy (the Milesian letter-number system) of the artist's name: Δημήτρης = Δ4 η8 μ40 ή8 τ300 ρ100 η8 ς200 = 668; Μάρης = Μ40 ά1 ρ100 η8 ς200 = 349. Attic acrophonic: ΗΗΗΗΗΗΔΔΔΔΔΔΠΙΙΙ and ΗΗΗΔΔΔΔΠΙΙΙΙ.
artist.note: Appears in metadata and on the collection page only, never on the frozen sheets. DA-MA-TE (Demeter's Linear B form) was excluded for name collisions.

archive.form: 256 zips (one per token: canonical PNG, companion PNG, metadata JSON) + SHA256SUMS.zips + manifest.json + verify.sh
archive.verification: verify.sh on the drive: 256 zip hashes OK, 769 entries extracted, all 768 files match manifest.json
archive.regeneration: byte-identical from the frozen generator with tools/strata-export.mjs and Playwright 1.56.1 (see README)

storage.scope: canonical PNG and companion PNG of every token; metadata JSON bound to ar:// URIs by tools/strata-publish.mjs after upload
reasons: permanence: one payment, data replicated by the network rather than kept alive by a pinning contract
fit with the platform decision: Manifold Studio stores media on Arweave by default
verifiability: each metadata file carries the SHA-256 of the bytes at its URI, so the on-sheet record, the manifest and the stored file can be checked against each other by anyone

rejected.IPFS: content-addressed but only as durable as its pinning; the edition would depend on a pinning service staying paid and alive

procedure: upload the 512 PNGs from the verified archive (any Arweave uploader; a bundler service is fine, the transaction ids are what matter)
convert the upload receipt to uris.json: { "<file>": "ar://<txid>" } for every file
node tools/strata-publish.mjs uris.json — refuses if any file is unmapped or any local file drifted from the manifest
spot-check: fetch a few URIs, hash the bytes, compare with the sha256 in the bound metadata
upload export/published/*.json (the bound metadata) and use those URIs as the token URIs at mint

reproduction.authoritative: the offline archive (see archive): its manifest hashes define the edition

toolchainOfRecord.note: last commit on main where the freeze verifies and every tool (sampler, selector, audit, freeze, reserve, export, publish) exists; the export tool was added after the tag

findings.detail: rendered under Playwright 1.63.0 / Chromium build 1243, token 1 gives different PNG bytes (canonical and companion) from the archived edition; the generator tree is identical, so the difference is Chromium rasterisation
findings.consequence: regeneration that must match the manifest hashes has to pin Playwright 1.56.1; any other build yields a valid but differently-hashed rendering

findings.what: freeze does not verify on main
findings.detail: assets/genart.js, one of the 26 fingerprinted files, was changed by PR #18 for another project; the export tool therefore refuses to run from main
findings.evidence: token 1 rendered at main (gate bypassed) and at d45ee08 are byte-identical, so the change did not alter drawings
findings.consequence: the fingerprint describes the tree at the tag, not main; regenerate from a checkout of d45ee08. The freeze is not re-done: the fingerprint is printed on every archived sheet and carried in every metadata file

mechanism.detail: all 256 tokens minted to the artist wallet with Manifold Batch Token Creator from a CSV (token id = edition number, metadata = the bound metadata from tools/strata-publish.mjs); the 24 reserves are held; the 232 offered tokens are listed at a fixed price and buyers choose their sheet
reasons: confirmed workable on a Manifold ERC-721 contract (unique tokens, batch mint, later sales from the same contract)
a curated, pre-rendered edition has nothing to reveal: the sheet is the token, so buyer choice is the honest sale
no platform fee on Manifold 1/1 minting; gas is the only mint cost and is paid once, up front

rejected.claim page with reveal: per-token unique metadata on Manifold claim pages is not confirmed; a reveal also hides a curated sheet behind a placeholder for no reason
rejected.auctions only: slow and labour-intensive for 232 lots; price discovery can happen on secondary
rejected.hybrid auction for legendary: splits the launch into two mechanisms for a first series; revisit for a later drop

pricing.exact: set within the band at listing time, after the comps brief; one number for every offered sheet
reasons: first series under a new pseudonym: distribution and sell-through over margin
the measured rarity and the tiers are on every sheet and in every metadata file; secondary can price them
tiering by rarity or view would price the top of a first series out of reach and adds admin

launch.rule: gated by readiness, no calendar date until the gates are met
launch.date: T = (Arweave bind complete) + 14 days of public preview

gates.gate: tools/strata-publish.mjs bound all 256 metadata files; spot-check of fetched bytes against sha256 passes
bound metadata uploaded; token URIs final; Batch Token Creator CSV generated from them
contract deployed on Ethereum mainnet via Manifold; 256 tokens batch-minted; reserves marked held
comps brief delivered; exact price fixed within the band
14-day preview: portfolio board public, collection page live, listings visible but not purchasable
